faq.q: What legal courses do you offer in Kazakhstan?
faq.a: Abadan & Co. runs courses on labour law, contract work, tax law, corporate law and compliance, subsoil use and environmental legislation, public procurement and foreign trade. Courses run in person in Almaty and online.

faq.q: How much do legal seminars cost?
faq.a: On the 2026 schedule — {minPrice} to {maxPrice} ₸ per participant, depending on the course and format. Online is cheaper than in person.

faq.q: Are the programmes current with the latest legislative changes?
faq.a: Yes, the programmes are updated to reflect changes in Kazakhstan’s legislation and are delivered by practising lawyers.

faq.q: Are there courses on Kazakhstan's labour law?
faq.a: Yes. It is one of our key areas, covering Kazakhstan’s Labour Code, labour disputes, and mediation.

faq.q: Are the courses suitable for lawyers without experience?
faq.a: Yes, we have programmes of different levels — from basics for related professionals to advanced courses for practising lawyers. The trainer adapts the material to the group's level.

faq.q: Do you issue a certificate for legal courses?
faq.a: Yes, at the end of the course you receive a personal Abadan & Co. certificate of professional development.
